name: lantern-chatgpt-oauth
description: Dedicated ChatGPT-compatible OAuth MCP entry point for Lantern Keeper (LK-CHAT-001). Implements OAuth discovery, dynamic client registration, PKCE, token validation and read-only scope enforcement via @cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider, then proxies authorised read tool calls to the existing bearer-authenticated lantern-keeper-mcp /mcp endpoint. Existing bearer clients are untouched.
